"Longer" is a song written and recorded by the American singer-songwriter Dan Fogelberg and released in 1979 by Full Moon Records and Epic Records.
The song can be found on Fogelberg's 1979 album Phoenix.
It was also included on his 1982 greatest hits album as well as various other retrospective and compilation recordings.
Phoenix is the sixth studio album by the American singer-songwriter Dan Fogelberg, released in 1979.
It was produced primarily by Fogelberg and Norbert Putnam.

Daniel Grayling Fogelberg (August 13, 1951 – December 16, 2007) was an American singer, songwriter, and multi-instrumentalist widely known for his 1970s and 1980s soft rock hits, including "Longer" (1979), "Same Old Lang Syne" (1980), and "Leader of the Band" (1981).
